usedFor: HubSpot holds the sales side and QuickBooks holds the money. When “When a deal is created or updated” fires in HubSpot, “Create Payment” in QuickBooks records a payment transaction.

bestTemplate.name: “When a deal is created or updated” in HubSpot, then “Create Payment” in QuickBooks
bestTemplate.why: Its only action here is “Create Payment”, and a deal change is the nearest HubSpot event to money being agreed. “New Or Updated Contact” carries less about what was bought.

watchOut: Both HubSpot triggers are polling and fire on updates as well as new records, so the same deal can run “Create Payment” more than once. Add a condition so only the stage you want records a payment.
